hints: Walk both trees together rather than one after the other. At a pair of positions, what are the possible cases?
Both missing - agreed so far. One missing and one not - different shapes, so false. Both present - the values must match and both pairs of children must match too.
That is three lines, and the shape check falls out of the 'one missing' case rather than needing its own pass.
Comparing two traversals as lists is not enough unless the nulls are written down: `[1, 2]` and `[1, null, 2]` have the same non-null preorder.
